name: Lexaloffle Games
summary: The small studio of Joseph White that made the PICO-8 fantasy console. The tool fixes a 128×128 pixel screen and a 16-colour palette for every game made with it.

statement.text: A fantasy console takes the limits of 1980s machines and makes them a rule of the tool, so that the limits give the games a look of their own.
statement.title: Summary of the PICO-8 design idea, not a quotation

moves.text: Joseph White revealed PICO-BASIC version 0.0, the first form of PICO-8.
